lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1667: the key goes where the player is

Owner, three things in one message: "the about tab, should that be there or
should it just be wrapped up in the log? it honestly doesn't mean anything to
anyone but you and me. the weapon glyphs section should be under the lore button
that lives on the minimap not in about, that should be easily player facing.
also audit the glyphs list to see if all of those damage types exist in game."

⚠⚠⚠ THE AUDIT ANSWER IS NO. FOUR OF THE THIRTEEN DID NOT EXIST.

Measured across all 301 catalog weapons, through the SAME baseDamageGlyph path
the combat buttons paint from:

    ⚒ bludgeoning 65    ▲ piercing 55    ✦ aetheric 49    ⚔ slashing 45
    🔥 burn 45          ⚡ electrical 22  ☠ poison 9       ❄ cold 6
    ☢ radiation 5
    ⚙ degradation 0     ✱ stun 0         ⚗ acid 0         ☣ corruption 0

⚠⚠ AND ⚙ WAS UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely unused. OTA-1652 aliased
`degradation → acid`, and baseDamageGlyph canonicalises BEFORE the glyph lookup —
so even a weapon authored with degradation prints ⚗. That row could not appear
on a button under any circumstances, and the key has promised it for 29 OTAs.

⚠ ACID AND CORRUPTION ARE NOT MISSING FROM THE GAME. They are missing as a
weapon's OWN damage. Both are live coating families with real vials (burn 3,
electrical 3, poison 3, cold 2, corruption 2, acid 1) and the COATS section
listed them correctly all along. The defect was listing them a SECOND time under
"own damage", where nothing can carry them.

⚠⚠⚠ SO THE FIX IS A DERIVATION, NOT A SHORTER LIST — and that is the part worth
keeping. A list I prune by hand today is wrong again the first time somebody
authors an acid-based weapon: the key would then HIDE a glyph the buttons paint,
the same lie pointing the other way. `baseTypesInPlay()` reads the catalog, so
both directions are now impossible and ota1667 is what holds it there.

THE KEY MOVED. It is the GLYPHS tab of the lore codex, third in the row behind
BEASTS and FALLEN — by the same rule OTA-1365 ordered that row with, how often
it is opened WHILE PLAYING. "What does ⚗ mean" is asked from inside a fight,
which is the worst possible moment to be told the answer is behind a gear icon,
under a build-id dump, in a settings screen. The card itself is unchanged and
still reads the live weaponGlyphs tables.

THE ABOUT TAB FOLDED AWAY, and he is right that the log already had it: every
COPY LOG export and every REPORT A BUG carries buildBasicDeviceSummary(), so the
tab was a THIRD copy of a thing that already reaches me two better ways. Nothing
was lost — the dedication, the seven-tap owner ritual (OTA-1490; both your
phones depend on it) and the third-party notices are one page now, called ABOUT,
with the dedication LEADING instead of buried under diagnostics where nobody
scrolls. SETTINGS is down to four tabs: SESSION · SFX · DISPLAY · ABOUT.

Gates: all 18 green by exit code. Full suite green.
